title: Sunflower Keys — Let one color linger before the five-color answer
rows: One low color in widening places
One high color in neighboring bands
help: A seed is a place, not a new pitch. The first two phrases stay on one of the five colors; the third gives each color two different places. Drawn preserves these entrances. Planting does not play.
message: phrases studies preserve their supplied values and independent memory
